title: Repetition code memory, distance 5 on grid5x5 — a small planar lattice
claim: 40 traps on the wires of a 5x5 junction grid. LER per round 0.00e+00, 95% interval 0.0e+00 to 3.8e-06 (0 errors in 200,000 shots)

marks.label: cool
marks.note: the lattice cools too; 13% of its round.

marks.label: the busiest shuttle (3 ions) / a typical shuttle / 1 directions at once
marks.note: the most ions this router ever moves at once, against a ring rotation's 144. The mean is 1.7. The device declares 18 SIMD classes (row and column shifts); the router issues only `shuttle`.  ALSO: a handful of ions, each on its own route: the 80% of this round that is transport is made of instructions like this one.  ALSO: ions moving 1 different ways in one instruction. A ring rotation asks for one. On the 32-channel broadcast block this needs 1 channels -- legal, and the reason q06h's 'a lattice cannot use broadcast' was withdrawn.

title: Repetition code memory, distance 5 on ring16 — the board's starter (ring: height 2, verticals 8, width 8)
claim: the design a new workspace starts from on this board. LER per round 0.00e+00, 95% interval 0.0e+00 to 3.8e-06 (0 errors in 200,000 shots)

marks.label: batch 1 of 40 / a 1-contact batch (40 of 40)
marks.note: a dock: 1 riders pull into their spurs at once. Each batch pays dock + undock + one forced cool (about 725 us) whatever its size; mean fill here is 1.0 contacts of 1 possible.  ALSO: one rider docks alone, and the batch still pays its full overhead: 40 such batches cost about 29.2 ms for 100.0% of the contacts.

marks.label: forced cool
marks.note: 300 us, once per batch: an ion that has crossed a junction carries 3 quanta against a 1-quantum gate budget, so the cool is structural, not a policy. It is about a quarter of the round.

marks.label: contact gates (1 pairs at once)
marks.note: the two-qubit gates of one batch, all in one instruction; each pair sits in its own dock. The Circuit pane shows which QASM statements this discharges.

marks.label: undock
marks.note: the riders leave their spurs. Entering the degree-3 rail node is charged as a junction crossing -- the price of the only mechanism a loop has.

marks.label: rigid rotation
marks.note: one loop_shift template turns the whole loop: every rider moves with one waveform. This is the broadcast primitive the ring is built around, and the reason it moves 72 ions per transport instruction.
